description: Eight-step sequencer and addressable switch: a clock, or a voltage, picks one of eight inputs and sends it on to the CV output

params.text: Scales what this step passes to the CV output, from nothing through to full level
Off, or a 1ms 10V pulse on the first or the second trigger output each time the sequencer reaches this step
Attenuates the CV output, from nothing through to full level
Sets which of the eight steps the sequence starts from
Attenuates the start input, narrowing how far 0-10V shifts the starting step
Sets how many steps the sequence runs before it returns to the start, one to eight
Attenuates the length input, narrowing how far 0-10V lengthens the sequence
Attenuates the address input, narrowing how far across the steps 0-10V reaches
Picks how the sequencer moves: forward, backward, pendulum, or a random step on each clock
Nothing in the module reads this control; the mode input is added to the mode knob at full level
Sequencer holds the selected step's voltage until the sequencer moves on; switch passes the selected input continuously, so a changing input is heard between steps

inputs.text: The voltage this step passes to the CV output; with nothing patched the step passes a fixed 10V
A rising edge moves the sequencer on one step, in the direction the mode knob sets
A rising edge jumps the sequencer to the step the start knob sets
Selects a step directly, 0-10V spanning the steps from the start knob over the set length; with a cable in the clock input it is read only on a clock edge
Shifts the starting step, 0-10V spanning all eight steps, added to the start knob and wrapping round
Adds to the length knob, 0-10V spanning eight steps and wrapping round at eight
Adds to the mode knob, 0-10V spanning the four ways of moving and wrapping round at the end

outputs.text: The selected step's voltage, scaled by that step's own attenuator and by the output attenuator
A 1ms 10V pulse each time the sequencer reaches a step whose switch is set to 1
A 1ms 10V pulse each time the sequencer reaches a step whose switch is set to 2

notes: In sequencer mode the CV output stays at 0V until the step changes, so a clock, an address voltage or a reset is needed before anything comes out
In switch mode the selected step's voltage is passed continuously from the moment the module is placed, with no clock needed
